'''Rubello Town''' (Japanese: '''ルイボスタウン''' ''Rooibos Town'') is an {{pkmn|animated series}}-exclusive location in [[Hoenn]]. It is located somewhere between [[Littleroot Town]] and [[Fortree City]]. Like many other {{cat|towns}} in the [[region]], it has a [[Contest Hall]].

{{Ash}} and {{ashfr}} arrived at Rubello Town in ''[[AG077|A Fan with a Plan]]''. There, they saw a poster for a [[Pokémon Contest]] slated to be held soon. {{an|Brock}} noticed the [[Rank (Contest)|R1]] sign on the poster, which they later learned from [[Nurse Joy]] that in order to enter the Rubello Contest, a {{pkmn|Coordinator}} must have obtained at least one [[Ribbon]].

[[File:Rubello Contest poster.png|thumb|left|200px|A poster for the town's R1 Pokémon Contest showing the Rubello Ribbon]]
Also in the [[Pokémon Center]] was [[Drew]], being mobbed by a group of women calling themselves the [[Mothers for Pokémon]], all of whom wanted his autograph because they were huge fans of his. One of them, named [[Savannah]], recognized {{an|May}} from the {{to|Verdanturf}} Contest and befriended her. Later, the group went grocery shopping with Savannah and her daughter [[Sandra]].

After shopping, the group had dinner, and Savannah—who was also entering the Rubello Contest—informed May that the competition would follow the [[Grand Festival]] rules, meaning that contestants would be required to switch {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} between the [[Appeal|Performance Stage]] and the [[Contest Battle|Battle Stage]].

The Rubello Contest took place in ''[[AG078|Cruisin' for a Losin']]''. In the first round, May performed with {{TP|May|Beautifly}}, Drew used his {{TP|Drew|Roselia}}, and Savannah selected her {{p|Flareon}}. The three of them were able to impress the [[Contest Judge|panel of judges]] and, along with [[Sonny]], advance to the Battle Stage.

Drew made quick work of Sonny, using his {{p|Masquerain}} to defeat his {{p|Girafarig}}, and advanced to the finals. May, on the other hand, had trouble during her battle with Savannah, since her {{TP|May|Bulbasaur}} suffered from {{wp|stage fright}} as she was competing in a Pokémon Contest for the first time. Bulbasaur ended up losing to Savannah's {{p|Lairon}}, but May wanted to win so badly that she pushed Bulbasaur even after the judges had ruled {{DL|Fainting|Battle Off}}. For this, she was scolded by the Chief of the [[Pokémon Activities Committee]], [[Raoul Contesta]].

In the final round, Drew went up against Savannah. When time ran out, the scoreboard showed that Drew had more points. As a result, [[Vivian Meridian|Vivian]] announced Drew as the winner of the R1 Rubello Town Pokémon Contest. This victory gave Drew his fourth Contest Ribbon, bringing him one step closer to the [[Hoenn Grand Festival]].
